target.statement: Cluster contribution S_{2,PC1} = 1.662 (sum of absolute PCA loadings of Murder, Assault, Rape on PC1) for the USArrests dataset with K=2 clusters

compute.basis: USArrests is a 50x4 built-in R dataset; PCA and K-means on a 4x50 transpose run in milliseconds, so the only cost is installing R/Python and downloading the tiny dataset.

blockers: Repo link in PDF is truncated ('PCA-') and may not resolve; code may need to be reimplemented from the algorithm description
K-means cluster assignment depends on random seed, so exact reproduction of the 2-cluster split may require matching the seed
title: An Approach to Variable Clustering: K-means in Transposed Data and its Relationship with Principal Component Analysis
